mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 6.5% over the past three months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precedes reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 6.5% for three consecutive months, or the Rank IC over a 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a contraction in consumer demand, which triggers a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 60 trading days as corporate revenue expectations are revised downward.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of rising industrial production (INDPRO > 100) and stable inflation (CPIAUCSL < 265), the economy is in a supply-driven expansion phase, which typically supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO > 100 and CPIAUCSL < 265, or the Rank IC for the regime signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A strong labor market, indicated by a high level of non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS > 140,000), signals robust economic activity and corporate hiring, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS exceeds 140,000, or the Rank IC over a 2-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 265 over the past three months signals accelerating inflation, which typically prompts the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 265 for three consecutive months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1400 thousand units over the past two months signals a weakening housing market, which typically reduces consumer wealth and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST is below 1400 for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC over a 2-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production (INDPRO) trend, indicated by a value above 100, consistently supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as it reflects expanding economic output and corporate capacity utilization.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 100, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
